name: zotero-cover-grid
description: Visual APA 7 Cover Grid view for Zotero 10 (Gecko 140 ESR)

scripts.reload: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-xpi.mjs && touch /tmp/zotero-cover-grid-reload.trigger && echo '[reload] Rebuilt XPI and reload trigger sent to Zotero!'
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
